displayTitle: The Mandalorian: The Path of the Force
synopsis: The Mandalorian: The Path of the Force is a World of Reading Level 2 young readers book by Brooke Vitale that adapts events from the second season of The Mandalorian television series. Meet the cast of characters from Star Wars: The Mandalorian! This Level 2 reader introduces young fans to memorable moments from the smash hit television series on Disney+, The Mandalorian! With dynamic full-color art and a story geared to help with reading, kids will love following along with some of their favorite action from season two.
title: The Mandalorian: The Path of the Force
